faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.lead: Need a real human? Reach out in Arabic or English. We reply within two business days.

items.question: What are the available age groups for the courses?
items.answer: The Python course is designed for kids aged 10 to 14. All other courses (C++ basics, Web, and OOP) are for adults aged 14 and above.

items.question: Can I join the C++ Advanced OOP course directly?
items.answer: Prerequisite for C++ Advanced OOP is a prior working knowledge of C++ fundamentals.

items.question: What are the requirements to start Advanced Web and Next.js courses?
items.answer: Web Foundations require no prior experience. JS & React requires web basics knowledge, and Next.js requires completing both preceding web levels.

items.question: Are the classes live or recorded?
items.answer: Classes are held weekly in a live, interactive format with instructors to ensure hands-on practice and clear any questions.

items.question: Will I get a certificate upon completion?
items.answer: Yes, learners receive a certificate of completion after finishing the required lectures, exercises, and projects for each course.
